analogue: Near-UV irradiation of isoprene-derived SOA producing gas-phase small oxygenated organics, including formic acid.
citation: Photodegradation of Secondary Organic Aerosol Particles as a Source of Small, Oxygenated Volatile Organic Compounds
evidence: An irradiated film of chamber-generated isoprene ozonolysis SOA emitted low molecular weight oxygenated products measured in the gas stream by PTR-ToF-MS.
difference: Collected material, film thickness, illumination and precursor oxidation conditions differed from suspended Manchester particles. The gas signal assignments and bulk rate are uncertain.
